Hannah / Marissa — quick notes after an initial look at the runtime logs for Turnstile (account DL-45872):

- Nov 16 at ~02:14 UTC we processed a large import request from your API key that started 7320 short sessions (avg duration 1.8s). The request was retried twice by the client within ~15s due to a 504 they saw; our dedup window is 10s for import jobs, so the retries appear to have been counted as separate sessions.
- There's a known edge case with the import batcher where sequential retries that have different request IDs can increment the session counter. We've pushed a patch to increase dedup window to 30s for batch imports, but that does not retroactively adjust counts.
- For reconciliation we can: (A) provide a per-request export with request_id, timestamp, session_id, tokens_billed; (B) produce an adjusted billing export that groups requests by external import job id (if present) and de-dupes by client-provided job_id.

For VAT / invoice correction: Naomi, if reverse-charge applies we should issue a credit for the VAT portion and resend INV-98421 with no VAT and new line items reflecting the credit. I can prepare the usage CSV and a grouped view for billing.

I'll generate the export and drop it here by EOD.

— Karthik

Alex / Lena — thank you for your patience. Summary and next steps below.

Findings:
- We exported per-request usage for Nov 1–30 and compared to your attached summary. The Nov 16 import had 3 attempts within 15s; because our import dedup window was set to 10s at the time, those retries were billed as separate sessions.
- Total billed sessions for Nov from that import were 7,320; de-duping by client_job_id reduces the count to 2,440 (we matched your internal total).

Resolution offered:
- We have issued a one-time billing credit of 4,880 billed sessions (applied as a token-credit) corresponding to the duplicated counts. Credit applied to account as line: CREDIT-98421-DEDUP (see corrected invoice attached).
- VAT: Naomi confirmed reverse-charge is applicable for Turnstile AI Netherlands (VAT ID: NL123456789B01). We removed the VAT line and reissued invoice INV-98421-C (corrected).

Attachments (stubs):
- turnstile_usage_export_20261201.csv — sanitized per-request export (columns: timestamp, request_id, external_job_id, session_id, tokens_billed)
- corrected-invoice-INV-98421.pdf — corrected invoice with credit and no VAT

Action items for Turnstile:
- Confirm the Netherlands VAT ID above (or provide corrected legal name/VAT) so we can finalize the invoice PDF and close the billing hold.
- Let us know if you'd like a small monthly alert (post-pay) for batch imports >1k sessions to prevent surprises.
